principle: Patterns are established mechanisms or composition templates, not unearned solutions. Each use requires a measured need and an isolated capability test.

patterns.name: residual/skip path
patterns.functional_hypothesis: preserve an easier representation and improve backward feature correction
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: useful early feature exists but degrades with depth or gradient flow

patterns.name: local horizontal causal mixing
patterns.functional_hypothesis: make short-range neighboring information directly accessible without burdening the global mechanism
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: required local context is present but expensive/inaccessible at the readout

patterns.name: standard gated update
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: different regimes require different memory retention

patterns.name: explicit multirate modules
patterns.functional_hypothesis: separate updates with distinct characteristic timescales
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: state families show reproducible timescale-separated drift

patterns.name: own predicted-state feedback
patterns.functional_hypothesis: make a physical Markov summary explicit
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: latent contains broad regime but exact phase/state is inaccessible

patterns.name: structured state-space memory
patterns.functional_hypothesis: represent stable long kernels and fast-slow responses efficiently
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: long memory and stable propagation fail under recurrence

patterns.name: continuous-time recurrent/vector-field operator
patterns.functional_hypothesis: encode continuous flow and explicit timing
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: fixed-step scaffold shows timescale or irregular-timing failure

patterns.name: shared local message passing
patterns.functional_hypothesis: factor local compartment updates from edge-mediated coupling
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: errors follow compartment distance or source-target structure

patterns.name: mixture/switching experts
patterns.functional_hypothesis: allocate specialized computation to separable dynamical regimes
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: regime is causally separable and a specialized expert independently works

patterns.name: wavelet or multiresolution path
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: errors are sharply scale-localized and spectral loss alone is insufficient

patterns.name: external/attentive retrieval
patterns.functional_hypothesis: retrieve a prior pattern by content rather than fixed delay
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: long recurrence depends on similarity not elapsed time

patterns.name: normalization/scaling primitive
patterns.diagnostic_trigger: measured activation or gradient scale pathology

composition_rule: A composite sketch must name the registered trigger and capability result for every pattern. Unvalidated fragments may appear only in a cheap synthetic sketch, never in a confirmatory composite.
